WITH target_keyword AS (
    SELECT k.id
    FROM keyword AS k
    WHERE k.keyword = '10,000-mile-club'
),
keyword_movies AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT mk.movie_id
    FROM movie_keyword AS mk
    JOIN target_keyword AS tk ON tk.id = mk.keyword_id
),
valid_linked_titles AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ml.linked_movie_id
    FROM movie_link AS ml
    JOIN title AS t2 ON t2.id = ml.linked_movie_id
),
qualified_links AS (
    SELECT ml.movie_id, ml.linked_movie_id, lt.link AS link_value
    FROM movie_link AS ml
    JOIN valid_linked_titles AS vt ON vt.linked_movie_id = ml.linked_movie_id
    JOIN keyword_movies AS km ON km.movie_id = ml.movie_id
    JOIN title AS t1 ON t1.id = ml.movie_id
    JOIN link_type AS lt ON lt.id = ml.link_type_id
),
minimum_link_type AS (
    SELECT MIN(ql.link_value) AS min_link
    FROM qualified_links AS ql
)
SELECT
    (SELECT min_link FROM minimum_link_type) AS link_type,
    (SELECT MIN(t1.title)
     FROM title AS t1
     WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM qualified_links AS ql WHERE ql.movie_id = t1.id)
    ) AS first_movie,
    (SELECT MIN(t2.title)
     FROM title AS t2
     WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM qualified_links AS ql WHERE ql.linked_movie_id = t2.id)
    ) AS second_movie
